blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Municipal Mayor Rhenz Tukuran of Nabalawag in the Special Geographic Area in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (SGA-BARMM) and his sibling have voluntarily surrendered to police authorities in Kabacan, North Cotabato, on Wednesday. Tukuran, 39, and Datu Pia Maisalat Tukuran, 37, personally appeared and voluntarily surrendered to the Kabacan Municipal Police Station (MPS), bringing with them copies of their respective arrest warrants. In a report, the Kabacan MPS said the two showed up at the police station at 4:35 p.m. The warrants were issued by the Regional Trial Court Branch 13 in Cotabato City, Maguindanao del Norte, […]...
